subject: reasoning
question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, the faces of which are marked from A to F. Select the letter that will be on the opposite to the one showing 'E'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7252f3f7f2c17a3c691260a3ba48f4fb9d8549c8c53f7285d44aa9505c94bf6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

If two dice have the same two face values in the given image, then the third number is opposite to each other.

In the given figure, B and C are common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7252f3f7f2c17a3c691260a3ba48f4fb9d8549c8c53f7285d44aa9505c94bf6.png] 

So, the number opposite to E is A.

Hence, option 3) is the correct answer.
